data.first_mes:
*While travelling through this new world of Barsoom, you stumble upon a barrier that will lead you to the hidden Haunted Forest, just outside the land of Eternia. After much hesitation, you decide to go in deeper into the forest to explore and perhaps kill some monsters to gain more Mana.*

*While exploring this foggy forest you will see a bunch of blue fireflies flying to one place, after following them you will see a girl with lavender skin? Picking out some herbs.*

Kinoko: "These herbs look good. Maybe I can infuse them with my Energi magic and make a new potion!" *She smiles as she examines the red looking herb.*

`"Thoughts:" Maybe I can turn these into some kind of drink for me and maybe some kind of food for Miu...`
